papers.title: First-Line Immunotherapy Versus Chemotherapy in MSI-H/dMMR Metastatic Colorectal Cancer: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis of Phase III Studies
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Metastatic colorectal cancer (mCRC) with microsatellite instability-high or mismatch repair deficiency (MSI-H/dMMR) demonstrates limited responsiveness to conventional cytotoxic chemotherapy but increased susceptibility to immune checkpoint inhibition. Although randomized phase III trials have shown superiority of immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICIs) in the first-line setting, a comprehensive synthesis of survival outcomes across key molecular and clinical subgroups remains warranted.
METHODS: We conducted a systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized, open-label, phase III trials comparing first-line ICI-based therapy with standard chemotherapy in MSI-H/dMMR mCRC. The primary endpoints were progression-free survival (PFS) and overall survival (OS). Prespecified subgroup analyses evaluated outcomes according to BRAF mutation status, KRAS/NRAS mutation status, and primary tumor location. Pooled hazard ratios (HRs) with 95% confidence intervals (CIs) were estimated using random-effects models. Safety outcomes were analyzed using Mantel-Haenszel fixed-effect models. Statistical heterogeneity was assessed using the I² statistic.
RESULTS: Two phase III trials (KEYNOTE-177 and CheckMate-8HW), including more than 600 patients, were eligible. ICI-based therapy significantly improved PFS compared with chemotherapy (pooled HR 0.61; 95% CI, 0.51-0.73; I²=0%) and demonstrated a significant OS benefit (pooled HR 0.77; 95% CI, 0.63-0.94; I²=0%). Immunotherapy was associated with lower rates of overall and grade ≥ 3 adverse events, despite more frequent immune-related toxicities.
CONCLUSIONS: First-line ICI-based therapy provides significant and consistent survival benefits across BRAF-mutated and wild-type tumors, KRAS/NRAS-mutated and wild-type disease, and both right- and left-sided primary tumors, supporting its role as the standard of care for MSI-H/dMMR mCRC.

papers.title_zh: MSI-H/dMMR轉移性大腸直腸癌一線免疫治療對比化療：第三期試驗之系統性回顧與統合分析
papers.abstract_zh:
背景：具微衛星不穩定性高(MSI-H)或錯配修復缺陷(dMMR)之轉移性大腸直腸癌(mCRC)對傳統細胞毒性化療反應有限，但對免疫檢查點抑制劑(ICI)較為敏感。儘管隨機第三期試驗已顯示ICI於一線治療優於化療，仍需針對關鍵分子與臨床亞群進行存活結果之綜合分析。
方法：本研究針對比較一線ICI治療與標準化療於MSI-H/dMMR mCRC之隨機、開放標籤第三期試驗進行系統性回顧與統合分析。主要終點為無惡化存活期(PFS)與總存活期(OS)。預先設定之亞組分析依BRAF突變狀態、KRAS/NRAS突變狀態及原發腫瘤位置評估結果。以隨機效應模型估計合併風險比(HR)及95%信賴區間(CI)。安全性結果以Mantel-Haenszel固定效應模型分析。統計異質性以I²統計量評估。
結果：共納入2篇第三期試驗(KEYNOTE-177與CheckMate-8HW)，涵蓋超過600名病人。ICI治療較化療顯著改善PFS(合併HR 0.61；95% CI, 0.51-0.73；I²=0%)，並顯示顯著OS效益(合併HR 0.77；95% CI, 0.63-0.94；I²=0%)。免疫治療雖伴隨較頻繁之免疫相關毒性，但整體及第三級以上不良事件發生率較低。
結論：一線ICI治療於BRAF突變與野生型腫瘤、KRAS/NRAS突變與野生型疾病、以及左右側原發腫瘤中皆提供顯著且一致之存活效益，支持其作為MSI-H/dMMR mCRC標準治療之地位。

papers.title: Surgical Options in the Treatment of Rectal Cancer: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis
papers.authors: Medina A, Moga M, Pi O, Hogea A, Misarca C, Hogea M
papers.abstract: Background: Rectal surgery has evolved through the combined efforts of anatomists and surgeons. Minimally invasive surgery has gained recognition over open surgery due to fewer perioperative complications, and faster postoperative recovery. Methods: A systematic search was conducted in PubMed, Scopus, and Web of Science to identify studies published between 2014 and December 2024 comparing laparoscopic surgery (LS) and open surgery (OS) for rectal cancer. Primary outcomes included postoperative complications, number of lymph nodes harvested, overall survival, and disease-free survival. Results: Eight randomized controlled trials and one non-randomized study, including a total of 3,935 patients, were analyzed. LS showed a lower incidence of postoperative complications [OR: 0.64; 95% CI, 0.53, 0.77; p=0.008] and a slight advantage in lymph node harvest (WMD: 0.66; 95% CI: -0.63Ã¢?"1.95). No significant differences were found in overall or disease-free survival. Conclusions: LS is a safe and effective option for rectal cancer treatment, offering better postoperative recovery and efficient lymph node retrieval, while maintaining long-term oncological outcomes comparable to OS.

papers.title_zh: 直腸癌手術選擇：系統性回顧與統合分析
papers.abstract_zh: 背景：直腸手術透過解剖學家與外科醫師的共同努力不斷演進。微創手術因併發症較少、術後恢復較快，已逐漸取代開腹手術獲得認可。方法：於PubMed、Scopus及Web of Science進行系統性搜尋，納入2014年至2024年12月間發表、比較腹腔鏡手術（LS）與開腹手術（OS）治療直腸癌之研究。主要結果指標包括術後併發症、淋巴結摘取數目、總體存活率及無病存活率。結果：共納入8篇隨機對照試驗及1篇非隨機研究，總計3,935名病人。LS術後併發症發生率較低〔OR: 0.64；95% CI, 0.53–0.77；p=0.008〕，淋巴結摘取數目略佔優勢（WMD: 0.66；95% CI: -0.63–1.95）。總體存活率與無病存活率兩組無顯著差異。結論：LS是治療直腸癌安全且有效的選擇，可提供較佳的術後恢復及有效的淋巴結摘取，同時維持與OS相當的長期腫瘤學結果。

papers.title: The Multi-Dimensional Learning Curve in Robotic-Assisted vs. Laparoscopic Rectal Cancer Resection: A Systematic Review of Procedural Efficiency, Pathological Integrity, and Ergonomic Impact
papers.authors: Arun Kumar G, Sharma G, Arun Kumar B
papers.abstract: The adoption of robotic-assisted surgery (RAS) for rectal cancer is governed by a steep learning curve (LC). This systematic review evaluates the "Price of Proficiency" by comparing RAS to conventional laparoscopic surgery (CLS) across temporal, oncological, and ergonomic dimensions. A systematic search of PubMed, Embase, and Scopus (2014-2026) identified 24 studies utilizing Cumulative Sum (CUSUM) or Risk-Adjusted CUSUM (RA-CUSUM) modeling. Methodological quality was appraised using MINORS and Cochrane RoB 2.0 tools. Synthesis of >3,500 procedures revealed a triphasic LC. Phase I (Learning: cases 1-25) demonstrated high operative times but remarkably low conversion rates (1.0%-3.2%) compared to historical CLS averages (12.2%- 15.0%). Technical proficiency (Phase II) stabilized by case 35, while Phase III (Mastery: >50 cases) was characterized by "Complexity Drift," where surgeons tackled high-BMI and post-radiation cases without compromising outcomes. Oncological quality, including TME completeness (91.9%-97.0%) and CRM negativity, remained stable throughout all LC phases. Mastery was associated with higher nodal yield and an increased likelihood of achieving a "Textbook Outcome". The robotic platform decouples procedural speed from surgical safety, providing an immediate "safety net" that protects oncological integrity during the initial learning phase. While RAS requires a significant temporal investment, its superior ergonomics and lower conversion rates support its transition as the standard for minimally invasive rectal cancer resection.

papers.title_zh: 機器手臂輔助與腹腔鏡直腸癌切除的多維度學習曲線：手術效率、病理完整性與人體工學影響之系統性回顧
papers.abstract_zh: 機器手臂輔助手術（RAS）在直腸癌的採用受制於陡峭的學習曲線（LC）。本系統性回顧透過比較RAS與傳統腹腔鏡手術（CLS）在時間、腫瘤學及人體工學面向，評估「熟練度的代價」。系統性檢索PubMed、Embase與Scopus（2014-2026），納入24篇使用累積和（CUSUM）或風險調整累積和（RA-CUSUM）建模的研究。方法學品質以MINORS與Cochrane RoB 2.0工具評估。統合超過3,500例手術後，顯示三階段學習曲線。第一階段（學習期：第1-25例）手術時間偏長，但轉開腹率極低（1.0%-3.2%），相較於歷史CLS平均值（12.2%-15.0%）明顯較低。技術熟練度（第二階段）於第35例時穩定，第三階段（精熟期：>50例）呈現「複雜度漂移」現象，外科醫師開始處理高BMI與放療後病例，而未犧牲手術結果。腫瘤學品質，包括TME完整性（91.9%-97.0%）與CRM陰性率，在所有學習曲線階段皆維持穩定。精熟期與較高的淋巴結摘取數及達成「教科書式結果」（Textbook Outcome）的可能性較高相關。機器手臂平台將手術速度與手術安全性脫鉤，在初期學習階段即提供「安全網」以保護腫瘤學完整性。雖然RAS需要顯著的時間投入，其優越的人體工學與較低的轉開腹率支持其成為微創直腸癌切除手術標準的轉變。
papers.score_reason: 納入24篇研究、超過3500例具規模，但多數比較對象為「歷史」CLS平均值而非同期對照，且無統合分析效應量，結論「應成為標準」過度推論。
papers.relevance_why: 學習曲線議題對正在建立或擴大機器手臂計畫的醫學中心有參考價值，但非直接治療決策證據。

papers.title: Artificial intelligence-based model for identifying anatomical and surgical structures in the videos of laparoscopic left hemicolectomy
papers.authors: Meng Z, Wang Y, Jiang Y, Han N, Zhong G, Xie Y
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Precise surgical procedures are critical to improving the survival outcomes for colon cancer patients. Currently, there is no dedicated intraoperative navigation system available for performing precise surgery.
OBJECTIVE: We aimed to innovate an artificial intelligence-based model for identifying anatomical structures and surgical instruments during laparoscopic left hemicolectomy, to assist surgeons in performing the surgery with greater precision.
DESIGN AND SETTINGS: A total of 7474 images, extracted from the operation videos of 56 patients, were included. Anatomical structures, including the fascia, avascular dissection plane, inferior mesenteric vessels and their branches, veins, ureter, reproductive blood vessels, pancreas, and nerves around the inferior mesenteric artery, were analyzed in each image. Surgical instruments, including clips, energy devices, and tissue forceps, were also analyzed. The Mask2Former model was trained using the annotated images.
PATIENTS: This was a multicenter study involving 56 randomly selected patients who had undergone laparoscopic or robotic left hemicolectomy between September 26, 2022, and June 25, 2025, at Sun Yat-Sen Memorial Hospital, Qilu Hospital of Shandong University and Guangdong Second Provincial General Hospital.
MAIN OUTCOME MEASURES: Intersection over Union (IoU), precision, recall and F1 score of the model.
RESULTS: A total of 7474 images were included; 6727 images were selected as a training set and 747 images as validation set. The mean precision of this model was 0.8643, the mean IoU was 0.7768, and the mean recall was 0.8756.
LIMITATIONS: First, the quality of the videos was inconsistent due to the different recording systems. Second, we should add images of suboptimal dissections to make this technology a more effective navigation aid during difficult dissections. Third, this model should be tested in real-time surgery navigation.
CONCLUSIONS: The artificial intelligence-based model can accurately identify anatomical structures and surgical instruments in laparoscopic left hemicolectomy.

papers.abstract_zh: 背景：精確的手術操作對於改善大腸癌患者的存活結果至關重要。目前尚無專用的術中導航系統可用於執行精確手術。目的：我們旨在開發一種基於人工智慧的模型，用於在腹腔鏡左半結腸切除術中辨識解剖結構與手術器械，以協助外科醫師更精確地執行手術。設計與場域：共納入7474張影像，取自56位患者的手術影片。每張影像分析的解剖結構包括：筋膜、無血管分離平面、腸繫膜下血管及其分支、靜脈、輸尿管、生殖血管、胰臟，以及腸繫膜下動脈周圍神經。手術器械分析包括夾子、能量裝置與組織鉗。使用標註影像訓練Mask2Former模型。患者：本為多中心研究，隨機選取56位於2022年9月26日至2025年6月25日間，在中山大學孫逸仙紀念醫院、山東大學齊魯醫院及廣東省第二人民醫院接受腹腔鏡或機器人左半結腸切除術的患者。主要結果測量：模型的交集聯集比（IoU）、精確度（precision）、召回率（recall）與F1分數。結果：共納入7474張影像；其中6727張作為訓練集，747張作為驗證集。此模型的平均精確度為0.8643，平均IoU為0.7768，平均召回率為0.8756。限制：首先，由於不同錄影系統，影片品質不一致。其次，應加入次優分離手術的影像，以使此技術在困難分離時成為更有效的導航輔助工具。第三，此模型應在即時手術導航中進行測試。結論：此基於人工智慧的模型能準確辨識腹腔鏡左半結腸切除術中的解剖結構與手術器械。

papers.title: Gut microbiota in health and disease
papers.authors: Li Y, Xiao X, Jiang X, Li X, Wang W, Lin R
papers.abstract: The gut microbiota is integral to host physiology, contributing to metabolic homeostasis, epithelial barrier integrity, immune balance, and bidirectional communication along gut-organ axes. Disruption of this ecosystem, commonly referred to as dysbiosis, is increasingly implicated in a wide range of gastrointestinal and extra-intestinal diseases. Rather than reflecting isolated compositional changes, microbiota-related pathology often involves interconnected disturbances in barrier function, microbial metabolism, immune regulation, genotoxicity, inflammatory and oncogenic signaling, and long-range communication with distal organs. However, key challenges remain, particularly in resolving causality, accounting for interindividual heterogeneity, and translating complex microbiome data into robust clinical tools. In this review, we summarize the role of the gut microbiota in maintaining host homeostasis and outline the concept, drivers, and consequences of dysbiosis. We then discuss the major mechanisms through which the gut microbiota contributes to disease development and progression, using colorectal cancer as a representative gastrointestinal example and gut-organ axes as a framework for extra-intestinal disorders. We further highlight current translational advances in microbiota-based biomarkers, dietary modulation, biotic and postbiotic strategies, fecal microbiota transplantation, and emerging precision microbiota therapies. By integrating mechanistic insights with translational perspectives, this review offers an updated framework for interpreting the gut microbiota in health and disease and may help inform the future development of more precise, mechanism-informed diagnostic and therapeutic strategies.

papers.title_zh: 健康與疾病中的腸道微菌叢
papers.abstract_zh: 腸道微菌叢是宿主生理不可或缺的一部分，參與代謝恆定、上皮屏障完整性、免疫平衡，以及沿腸道-器官軸的雙向溝通。此生態系統的破壞，通常稱為菌叢失衡（dysbiosis），越來越多被牽連至廣泛的腸胃道及腸道外疾病。微菌叢相關病理往往不只是單純的組成改變，而是涉及屏障功能、微生物代謝、免疫調節、基因毒性、發炎與致癌訊號傳導，以及與遠端器官長程溝通之間相互關聯的紊亂。然而，關鍵挑戰仍然存在，特別是在釐清因果關係、考量個體間異質性，以及將複雜的微菌叢數據轉譯為可靠的臨床工具方面。在這篇綜述中，我們總結腸道微菌叢在維持宿主恆定中的角色，並概述菌叢失衡的概念、驅動因子與後果。接著我們討論腸道微菌叢促成疾病發生與進展的主要機制，以大腸直腸癌作為腸胃道代表性範例，並以腸道-器官軸作為腸道外疾病的架構。我們進一步強調目前在微菌叢相關生物標記、飲食調節、益生菌與後生元策略、糞便微菌叢移植，以及新興精準微菌叢治療方面的轉譯進展。透過整合機制性見解與轉譯觀點，本綜述提供了一個更新的架構，以詮釋健康與疾病中的腸道微菌叢，並可能有助於未來發展更精準、機制導向的診斷與治療策略。

papers.title: Comparative outcomes of robotic versus laparoscopic total proctocolectomy
papers.authors: Rudasill S, Tang R, Bossie H, Cauley C, Goldstone R, Kunitake H
papers.abstract: Total proctocolectomy (TPC) with end ileostomy is performed for inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) or diffuse polyposis/malignancy, but evidence regarding robotic versus laparoscopic TPC remains limited. We hypothesized that robotic TPC is associated with lower conversion rates. We queried the National Surgical Quality Improvement Program's proctectomy database (2016-2023) for adult patients undergoing elective TPC for IBD or polyposis/malignancy. Cases were categorized by intended approach (robotic versus laparoscopic). Conversion to open surgery served as the primary endpoint, with operative time, postoperative organ space infections, and renal complications as secondary outcomes. Among 2,035 patients, 1,505 (74%) underwent laparoscopic and 530 (26%) robotic TPC. Robotic utilization increased from 13% in 2016 to 38% in 2023 (p < 0.001). The robotic approach was more frequently utilized for male patients (59.1% vs. 50.2%, p < 0.001) and those with malignancy (47.4% vs. 32.1%, p < 0.001) and preoperative chemotherapy (17.6% vs. 9.6%, p < 0.001). Conversion to open surgery occurred less often with the robotic approach (5.5% vs. 8.8%, p = 0.01), though operative duration was longer (398 vs. 311 min, p < 0.001). In adjusted models, robotic TPC showed lower odds of conversion (OR = 0.66 [95% CI 0.45-0.96]) but higher odds of organ space infection (OR = 1.57 [95%CI 1.10-2.23]) and renal complications (OR = 2.25 [95%CI 1.13-4.47]), with 78 additional minutes of operative time (β = 78 [95%CI 66-90]). Robotic TPC is associated with lower conversion rates but prolonged operative time and increased incidence of renal complications and organ space infections. These results aid patient counseling and inform preoperative decision making.

papers.title: Robotic versus laparoscopic colectomy for deep infiltrative endometriosis of the bowel: a propensity-matched analysis of US-based hospitals
papers.authors: Elhadi M, Arellano D, LeFave J, Haas E
papers.abstract: Deep infiltrative endometriosis involving the bowel is a complex disease in which the optimal minimally invasive surgical approach remains uncertain, particularly regarding long-term fertility, recurrence, and healthcare utilization. We conducted a retrospective propensity score-matched cohort study using the TriNetX US Collaborative Network, including 72 healthcare organizations. Adult women who underwent minimally invasive colectomy for colorectal endometriosis between October 2013 and October 2025 were identified. Patients with prior hysterectomy, malignancy, inflammatory bowel disease, adenomyosis, or conversion to open surgery were excluded. Robotic colectomy was compared with conventional laparoscopic colectomy. After 1:1 propensity score matching, 487 patients were included in each cohort, with balanced baseline characteristics. At 3 years, robotic colectomy was associated with higher pregnancy achievement compared with laparoscopy (7.2% vs 2.9%; RR 2.50, 95% CI 1.36-4.59), lower endometriosis recurrence (4.3% vs 20.1%; RR 0.21, 95% CI 0.14-0.34), and reduced long-term opioid utilization (68.4% vs 89.3%; RR 0.77, 95% CI 0.72-0.82). At 5 years, these benefits persisted, with higher pregnancy achievement (7.8% vs 3.3%), lower recurrence (4.7% vs 18.5%), reduced opioid utilization (68.0% vs 90.3%), and fewer emergency readmissions (26.7% vs 35.1%). No significant differences were observed in urinary dysfunction, urinary incontinence, pelvic or perineal pain, dysmenorrhea, or dyspareunia. In this propensity-matched analysis, robotic colectomy was associated with higher recorded pregnancy and lower recurrence, opioid use, and readmission; given shorter follow-up and no fertility-intent data, these associations are hypothesis-generating.

papers.abstract_zh: 腸道深部浸潤型子宮內膜異位症是複雜疾病，最佳微創手術方式仍不確定，尤其在長期生育力、復發及醫療利用方面。本研究利用 TriNetX 美國協作網路（涵蓋72家醫療機構）進行回溯性傾向分數配對世代研究。納入2013年10月至2025年10月間因大腸直腸子宮內膜異位症接受微創結腸切除術之成年女性。排除曾接受子宮切除、惡性腫瘤、發炎性腸病、腺肌症或轉開腹手術者。比較機器人手臂輔助結腸切除術與傳統腹腔鏡結腸切除術。經1:1傾向分數配對後，兩組各納入487人，基線特徵平衡。3年時，機器人手臂組懷孕達成率較高（7.2% vs 2.9%；RR 2.50，95% CI 1.36-4.59），子宮內膜異位症復發率較低（4.3% vs 20.1%；RR 0.21，95% CI 0.14-0.34），長期鴉片類藥物使用率降低（68.4% vs 89.3%；RR 0.77，95% CI 0.72-0.82）。5年時上述效益持續，懷孕達成率較高（7.8% vs 3.3%）、復發率較低（4.7% vs 18.5%）、鴉片類藥物使用率降低（68.0% vs 90.3%），且急診再入院較少（26.7% vs 35.1%）。在泌尿功能障礙、尿失禁、骨盆或會陰疼痛、經痛或性交疼痛方面則無顯著差異。本傾向分數配對分析顯示機器人手臂結腸切除術與較高的懷孕記錄、較低的復發、鴉片類藥物使用及再入院相關；然而由於追蹤時間較短且缺乏生育意圖資料，此關聯僅屬假說產生性質。

papers.title: Comparative Performance of Postoperative Day 3 Biomarkers for Predicting Anastomotic Leakage after Colorectal Cancer Surgery - A Retrospective Cohort Study
papers.authors: Ghirlea O, Paşca P, Georgescu D, Duţă C, Olariu S, Murariu M
papers.abstract: Background: Anastomotic leakage (AL) represents a serious postoperative complication after surgery, especially for digestive tract malignancies, concerning both patients and surgeons. Due to severe clinical repercussions, early identification of patients at risk is essential for improving postoperative outcomes. This study focused on assessing clinical risk factors and the postoperative day 3 (POD 3) biomarkers in early detection of anastomotic leakage. Materials and Methods: A retrospective observational study was conducted including 166 patients who underwent resection with primary anastomosis for colorectal cancer. Patient-related factors, tumor characteristics, operative factors, and POD 3 laboratory data were collected. Receiver operating characteristics (ROC) curves and logistic regression models were used to assess predictive performance and identify independent risk factors. Results: Anastomotic leakage occurred in 44 patients (26.50%) and was associated with prolonged hospitalization and higher postoperative mortality (25.00% vs 6.60%, p=0.002). Multivariable logistic regression identified emergency surgery, rectal tumor location, intraoperative transfusion, and open surgical approach as independent risk factors. Among POD 3 biomarkers, C-reactive protein-to-albumin ratio (CAR) demonstrated the highest predictive accuracy for AL. After adjustment in the multivariable model, CAR remained an independent predictor of AL (OR=1.91, p 0.001). Conclusions: Anastomotic leakage after colorectal cancer surgery remains a multifactorial complication influenced by operative conditions, local tumor-related factors, and the postoperative inflammatory response. In this retrospective cohort, POD 3 CAR showed the highest discriminatory performance among the evaluated biomarkers and may support early postoperative risk stratification when interpreted with clinical findings and operative risk factors.

papers.title_zh: 術後第三天生物標記預測大腸直腸癌手術後吻合口滲漏之比較表現—回溯性世代研究
papers.abstract_zh: 背景：吻合口滲漏（AL）是消化道惡性腫瘤手術後的嚴重併發症，對病人與外科醫師皆造成極大關切。由於臨床後果嚴重，及早辨識高風險病人對改善術後預後至關重要。本研究聚焦於評估臨床危險因子與術後第三天（POD 3）生物標記在早期偵測吻合口滲漏中的角色。方法：本回溯性觀察研究納入166名接受大腸直腸癌切除併一期吻合手術的病人。收集病人相關因子、腫瘤特徵、手術相關因子及POD 3實驗室數據。使用受試者操作特徵（ROC）曲線與邏輯迴歸模型評估預測效能並辨識獨立危險因子。結果：44名病人（26.50%）發生吻合口滲漏，與住院時間延長及較高術後死亡率相關（25.00% vs 6.60%，p=0.002）。多變項邏輯迴歸分析顯示，急診手術、直腸腫瘤位置、術中輸血及開腹手術方式為獨立危險因子。在POD 3生物標記中，C反應蛋白與白蛋白比值（CAR）展現最高預測準確度。經多變項模型校正後，CAR仍為吻合口滲漏的獨立預測因子（OR=1.91，p<0.001）。結論：大腸直腸癌手術後吻合口滲漏仍是受手術條件、局部腫瘤相關因子及術後發炎反應影響的多因子併發症。在此回溯性世代中，POD 3 CAR在所評估的生物標記中顯示最高鑑別效能，若能與臨床發現及手術危險因子合併判讀，或可協助早期術後風險分層。

papers.title: α-fluoro-β-alanine functions as a β-arrestin1-biased ligand of S1PR2 to upregulate DPD expression in cancer cells
papers.journal: Proc Natl Acad Sci U S A
papers.journal_full: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences of the United States of America
papers.authors: Tan M, Shao H, Zhang X, Cheng Y, Sun Z, Yang M
papers.abstract: α-fluoro-β-alanine (FBAL), a catabolite of the chemotherapeutic agent 5-fluorouracil (5-FU), has attracted significant attention due to its cardiotoxicity and neurotoxicity. However, its association with 5-FU resistance, a major obstacle in cancer treatment, has rarely been reported. In this study, FBAL was identified as a β-arrestin1-biased ligand of sphingosine 1-phosphate receptor 2 (S1PR2), which upregulates dihydropyrimidine dehydrogenase (DPD) expression and drives 5-FU resistance in colorectal cancer. Mechanistically, following exposure to FBAL, S1PR2, a G protein-coupled receptor (GPCR), is phosphorylated by recruiting G protein-coupled receptor kinase 6 (GRK6). Phosphorylated S1PR2 coupled with β-arrestin1, but not G proteins, to activate the MEK/ERK/AP-1 pathway and promote DPYD transcription. Ser343 was identified as the key phosphorylation site of S1PR2 using IP-MS analysis. This residue within the C-terminal domain mediates receptor interaction with β-arrestin-1 to activate the β-arrestin-1-dependent ERK pathway, as was confirmed in HCT116S1PR2KO-ΔC cells and HCT116S1PR2KO-S343A cells. In vivo, mice bearing orthotopic xenografts of HCT116S1PR2KO-S343A cells exhibited significantly enhanced higher sensitivity to 5-FU treatment compared to those HCT116S1PR2KO-WT cells following FBAL. Taken together, this study showed that exposure to FBAL induces S1PR2 phosphorylation at Ser343 within the C-terminal mediated by GRK6, activating the β-arrestin1-dependent ERK pathway to upregulate DPD expression. This study not only delineates a phosphorylation-dependent signaling pathway in chemoresistance but also establishes S1PR2 as a promising therapeutic target for overcoming 5-FU resistance in cancer.
papers.title_zh: α-fluoro-β-alanine 作為 S1PR2 的 β-arrestin1 偏向性配體，上調癌細胞中 DPD 表現
papers.abstract_zh: α-fluoro-β-alanine (FBAL) 是化療藥物 5-fluorouracil (5-FU) 的代謝產物，因其心臟毒性與神經毒性而受到關注。然而，其與 5-FU 抗藥性（癌症治療的主要障礙）的關聯卻鮮少被報導。本研究發現 FBAL 是鞏胺醇-1-磷酸受體 2 (S1PR2) 的 β-arrestin1 偏向性配體，可上調二氫嘧啶脫氫酶 (DPD) 的表現，並驅動大腸直腸癌對 5-FU 的抗藥性。機轉上，暴露於 FBAL 後，S1PR2（一種 G 蛋白偶聯受體，GPCR）會透過招募 G 蛋白偶聯受體激酶 6 (GRK6) 而被磷酸化。磷酸化的 S1PR2 與 β-arrestin1（而非 G 蛋白）偶聯，活化 MEK/ERK/AP-1 訊號路徑並促進 DPYD 基因轉錄。透過 IP-MS 分析，Ser343 被確認為 S1PR2 的關鍵磷酸化位點。此位於 C 端結構域的殘基介導受體與 β-arrestin-1 的交互作用，以活化 β-arrestin-1 依賴性 ERK 路徑，此結果在 HCT116 S1PR2KO-ΔC 細胞及 HCT116 S1PR2KO-S343A 細胞中得到證實。在動物實驗中，帶有 HCT116 S1PR2KO-S343A 細胞原位異體移植瘤的小鼠，在給予 FBAL 後，相較於帶有 HCT116 S1PR2KO-WT 細胞的小鼠，對 5-FU 治療展現出顯著更高的敏感性。總結而言，本研究顯示暴露於 FBAL 會誘導 S1PR2 在 C 端 Ser343 位點被 GRK6 介導磷酸化，進而活化 β-arrestin1 依賴性 ERK 路徑以上調 DPD 表現。本研究不僅闡明了化療抗藥性中一條磷酸化依賴性訊號路徑，也確立 S1PR2 為克服癌症 5-FU 抗藥性的潛力治療靶點。

papers.title: COLOSSUS-AI: A Pilot Study on Artificial Intelligence Driven Prediction of Postoperative Outcomes in Colorectal Surgery
papers.authors: Botoncea M, Cosma C, Nicolescu C, Butiurca V, Molnar D, Molnar C
papers.abstract: Background: Postoperative complications remain a major source of morbidity after colorectal surgery and are associated with prolonged hospitalization, reintervention, intensive care unit admission, and increased mortality. Early identification of high-risk patients remains challenging due to the heterogeneity of colorectal surgical populations. Artificial intelligence and machine learning methods may support individualized risk prediction by integrating clinical, biological, and operative variables. Aim: This study aimed to develop and internally evaluate a preliminary machine learning model, named COLOSSUS-AI, for predicting early postoperative adverse outcomes after colorectal surgery. Material and Methods: This retrospective, single-center, observational pilot study included 310 patients undergoing colorectal surgery. Demographic, clinical, laboratory, disease-specific, operative, and postoperative data were retrospectively collected and organized into a structured database comprising 84 variables. The primary endpoint was postoperative adverse outcome. Three predictive models were evaluated: logistic regression, random forest, and gradient boosting. Model performance was assessed using receiver operating characteristic curve analysis, area under the curve, accuracy, sensitivity, and specificity. Results: Postoperative adverse outcomes occurred in 120 patients (38.7%). Adverse outcomes were associated with older age, urgent or emergency admission, increased inflammatory markers, higher neutrophil-to-lymphocyte ratio, lower preoperative albumin, impaired renal function parameters, anastomotic leak, and in-hospital mortality. Among the evaluated models, gradient boosting achieved the best predictive performance, with an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve of 0.886, accuracy of 81.7%, sensitivity of 72.2%, and specificity of 87.7%. Random forest achieved an area under the curve of 0.841, while logistic regression achieved an area under the curve of 0.768. Conclusions: The COLOSSUS-AI pilot study suggests that routinely collected perioperative data can be used to develop exploratory machine learning models for predicting postoperative adverse outcomes after colorectal surgery. Although gradient boosting showed the best preliminary performance, these findings should be interpreted cautiously. External validation in larger multicenter cohorts is required before clinical implementation.

papers.title_zh: COLOSSUS-AI：人工智慧預測大腸直腸手術術後結果之前導性研究
papers.abstract_zh: 背景：術後併發症仍是大腸直腸手術後主要的病態來源，與住院時間延長、再介入、加護病房入住及死亡率增加相關。由於大腸直腸手術族群異質性高，早期辨識高風險病人仍具挑戰性。人工智慧與機器學習方法或可整合臨床、生物與手術變項，支援個人化風險預測。目的：本研究旨在開發並進行內部評估一個名為COLOSSUS-AI的初步機器學習模型，用以預測大腸直腸手術後早期不良結果。材料與方法：此為回溯性、單中心、觀察性前導研究，納入310名接受大腸直腸手術的病人。回溯性收集人口學、臨床、實驗室、疾病特異性、手術及術後資料，建構包含84項變數的結構化資料庫。主要終點為術後不良結果。評估三種預測模型：邏輯迴歸、隨機森林及梯度提升。以受試者操作特徵曲線分析、曲線下面積、準確度、敏感度及特異度評估模型表現。結果：120名病人（38.7%）發生術後不良結果。不良結果與年齡較大、緊急或急診入院、發炎指標升高、嗜中性球與淋巴球比值升高、術前白蛋白較低、腎功能受損指標、吻合口漏及院內死亡有關。在評估的模型中，梯度提升表現最佳，受試者操作特徵曲線下面積為0.886，準確度81.7%，敏感度72.2%，特異度87.7%。隨機森林曲線下面積為0.841，邏輯迴歸曲線下面積為0.768。結論：COLOSSUS-AI前導研究顯示，常規收集的圍手術期資料可用於開發探索性機器學習模型以預測大腸直腸手術後不良結果。儘管梯度提升在初步表現上最佳，這些發現應審慎解讀。臨床應用前需在更大規模、多中心世代中進行外部驗證。

papers.title: Robotic surgery for rectal cancer in 2026: a hierarchical appraisal of the evidence
papers.authors: Silva-Vaz P, Cruz M, Tralhão J
papers.abstract: Robotic total mesorectal excision (TME) now rests on an evidence base that has accumulated layer by layer: randomized trials, meta-analyses, registry cohorts, and dedicated functional-outcomes studies. The publication of the long-term results of the REAL trial (2025) marked a turning point. We propose a hierarchical evidence framework in which the REAL trial functions as confirmatory apex rather than foundational basis. It provided the first randomized evidence of better locoregional control and disease-free survival with robotic surgery compared to laparoscopy (3-year locoregional recurrence 1.6% vs. 4.0%; absolute risk reduction 2.4%; HR 0.45). This narrative review synthesizes the current evidence comparing robotic TME with laparoscopic TME, framing the most recent randomized data within the broader context of the accumulated literature. Across multiple study designs, robotic TME is consistently associated with lower conversion rates, better circumferential resection margin negativity in selected subgroups, and better preservation of urinary and sexual function. These advantages are amplified in male patients, those with obesity, post-neoadjuvant fibrosis, and lower rectal tumors. Important caveats remain: REAL was conducted exclusively at high-volume Chinese centers, an overall survival benefit has not yet been demonstrated, and cost and access barriers continue to shape global adoption. Evidence in 2026 supports robotic TME as the preferred minimally invasive approach for mid-to-low rectal cancer in centers with established expertise, adequate infrastructure, and case volume. When these conditions are not met, expert laparoscopic TME retains its place. Five-year data and validation across diverse healthcare systems are needed before a universal recommendation can be made.
papers.title_zh: 2026年直腸癌機器人手術：證據的階層式評析
papers.abstract_zh: 機器人全直腸系膜切除術（TME）的證據基礎已逐層累積：隨機對照試驗、統合分析、註冊資料庫世代研究，以及專門的功能性結果研究。2025年REAL試驗長期結果的發表標誌著一個轉折點。我們提出一個階層式證據框架，其中REAL試驗扮演驗證性頂點的角色，而非奠基性基礎。該試驗首次提供隨機證據，顯示機器人手術相較於腹腔鏡手術有更好的局部區域控制與無病存活：3年局部區域復發率1.6% vs. 4.0%；絕對風險降低2.4%；HR 0.45。本篇敘述性綜述綜合了目前比較機器人TME與腹腔鏡TME的證據，將最新的隨機化資料放入累積文獻的更廣泛背景中討論。跨越多種研究設計，機器人TME一致地與較低的轉開放率、在特定次群組中較佳的環周切緣陰性率、以及較佳的泌尿與性功能保留有關。這些優勢在男性病人、肥胖病人、新輔助治療後纖維化病人、以及低位直腸腫瘤病人中更為明顯。重要的注意事項仍存在：REAL試驗僅在中國高流量中心進行、尚未證實整體存活益處、且成本與可及性障礙持續影響全球採用。2026年的證據支持在具備完備專業能力、充足基礎設施與病例量的中心，將機器人TME視為中低位直腸癌的優先微創手術方式。當這些條件未滿足時，專家級腹腔鏡TME仍有其地位。在做出普遍性建議之前，仍需要5年資料以及跨不同醫療體系的驗證。
